title: A countable family of test forms that is C¹-sequentially dense in 𝒟ⁿ(U) with common compact supports
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Then there is a countable set D ⊆ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n: C^∞ compactly supported n-forms on ℝ^P whose topological support lies in U) with the following property. For every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) there are a compact set K ⊆ U with tsupport ω ⊆ K and a sequence (ω_k)_{k∈ℕ} in D such that tsupport ω_k ⊆ K for every k, ω_k → ω uniformly on ℝ^P, and dω_k → dω uniformly on ℝ^P. Here d = exteriorDerivative, and uniform convergence of covector-valued maps is with respect to the operator norm of covectors (the norm of Covector (Euclid P) k).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → ∃ D : Set (TestFormOn U n), D.Countable ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K ∧ (∀ k, ωs k ∈ D) ∧ (∀ k, tsupport (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) atTop ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => exteriorDerivative (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) atTop
